JavaScript & TypeScript interview prep

JS & TS Interview Lab

Everything you need to get ready for a JavaScript or TypeScript interview, in one page. Learn has plain-language lessons with examples and self-checks. Code challenges are LeetCode-style problems with hidden tests, including TypeScript problems checked by the real compiler. The Output quiz trains you to read tricky code. Interview questions come with model answers and a mock interview mode.

JavaScript runs in an isolated worker inside this page, with a 5-second limit per run. TypeScript problems are checked by the real TypeScript compiler, which loads once from jsDelivr the first time you run one. Drafts and progress are saved in this browser only.
